front.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING

“There is a final MEDUSA trial, by far the most severe strain they have created.

The trial is to take place in North America, and...you must prevent all of the trials. The PEARL Compound is their source for MEDUSA, so you may be able to find their loading dock and replace their samples with a placebo.

There is an extreme risk of exposure to the pathogen if you do this, but there may not be another way.

Your final objective is to bug another control center. I recognize that it may be a lower priority, but intercepting Soviet data remains important.”

front.transcription:
This is a disrupt trial objective.

To set it up, separate the 8 North America City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 3 of them faceup into the Operations area. These are the 3 trial cities.

Then shuffle the remaining North America cards back into the Player deck.

Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the 3 trial city cards.
